title: CarrierTracking
description: A Carrier's tracking message, as the Carrier sends it to the Norvia Partner API (Carrier tracking format, version 1). It differs from the Canonical Model on purpose: its own field names, flat location fields, a local date/time without an offset, alpha-3 country codes and a shared status code list. It never names the Carrier: API Management takes the Carrier from the token (ADR 0005).

bookingRef.description: The Carrier's own reference for its booking.

carrierBookingNumber.description: The Norvia Carrier booking number, such as CB-0000042. Used only when the reference doesn't match.

eventId.description: The Carrier's own ID for the event, unique per Carrier.

eventTime.description: When it happened, local to the location, without an offset.

eta.description: The ETA, local to the delivery address, without an offset. Optional.
